title: Statistical Inference with R
text:
Statistical Inference with R
    Workshop Series · GW Libraries & Academic Innovation · Fall 2026
    Dan Kerchner · George Washington University
  

  

    
      1
      
        Inference for Continuous Data
        
          t-tests, confidence intervals, and ANOVA for comparing means.
          Assumptions, diagnostics, and visualizations.
        
      
      →
    

    
      2
      
        Inference for Categorical Data
        
          Chi-square tests, proportions, and Fisher's exact test.
          Working with counts and contingency tables in R.
        
      
      →
    

    
      3
      
        Linear & Logistic Regression Modeling
        
          Build, interpret, and evaluate linear and logistic regression models.
          Predictors, model fit, and predictions in R.
        
      
      →
